name_reason: Conforms to data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. Domain=chapter; 'ch14' is the chapter ID (14 = Ping Yuan battle, a meaningful 01-30 chapter ID, must be kept -- not Ghidra address residue). 'pos_x_table' reflects the data type (a flat per-character X-position table). No Ghidra address suffix. Accurately describes the table.
purpose: Per-character X battle-tile coordinate for the chapter 14 (Ping Yuan battle) end scene, used to position chars 0..0xF during the cutscene-to-battle intro.
logic_summary: fd2_chapter_14_end (0x238DC) copies all 16 bytes onto an on-stack placement block via MOVSD x4, then passes the block as the pos_x argument to fd2_setup_chars_and_camera_for_intro (0x233C6). That function loops char_idx over [0,0xF] inclusive and executes runtime_char[char_idx].bPos_x = pX_byte_array[char_idx] (one byte per char, stride 1, no scaling). Read-only lookup table.
element_semantics: One unsigned byte per character index 0..0xF = that character's X battle-tile coordinate for the chapter-14 end scene. Values 15..21. Stored verbatim into runtime_char.bPos_x by fd2_setup_chars_and_camera_for_intro.
notes: Memory @0x52153 first 16 bytes = {18,17,19,18,17,19,16,20,16,15,15,16,20,21,21,20} match src array byte-for-byte. Only xrefs are READ/DATA from fd2_chapter_14_end (no writers) -> confirms const. Adjacent tables: pos_y_table @0x52163, facing_table @0x52173 (same chapter-14 end scene). src comment block (chtab2.c lines 40-52) already precise+ASCII+accurate -> comment kept, src not edited. Ghidra plate was null -> created concise plate matching src (data plate via PLATE_COMMENT). No logic touched.
